title: DatasetVersion
description: The wire form of one dataset_versions row (0006_evidence.up.sql section 3): chapter 7's sealed, immutable cohort. Response body of table 10.2-B row 37, and the first of the three ids POST /api/v1/training-runs binds (MOS-TRAIN-124). It exists on this surface because MOS-UI-147 renders the cohort as a read-only summary and a console that could see its cohort only through the SealRun that made it would lose the summary the next day. THE ROW IS IMMUTABLE AND THE WIRE FORM SAYS SO: MOS-EVID-013 forbids editing it, MOS-EVID-023 makes a change a new version, MOS-API-011 answers a delete on a sealed one with 409 DATASET_VERSION_SEALED, and MOS-UI-139 requires the console to have stated all of that in plain language BEFORE the seal and without using the word `immutable` unglossed. `status` and `erasure_state` are the only mutable evidence state on the row and neither is reachable from this surface.

parent_version_id.description: MOS-EVID-022: set whenever a version is derived from another by inclusion, exclusion or re-de-identification. MOS-TRAIN-118 and MOS-TRAIN-119 make it the only accepted remedy for an L2 or L5 hit -- write a patient_key_aliases row, re-seal with this set and a merge derivation, re-freeze the split -- and moving a study across partitions is refused as a remedy precisely because it would leave this null.

manifest_digest.description: Chapter 7's dataset_version_digest, UNIQUE per tenant: MOS-TRAIN-209 makes sealing idempotent on content, and this column is why a re-seal after a fix reuses the identity rather than minting a second one for the same bytes.

patient_count.description: The denominator every bound in MOS-UI-115's composition panel is taken against, and the one MOS-TRAIN-114's floor of thirty test patients is computed from. dataset_versions_counts CHECKs patient_count <= case_count: a case is one study of one patient, so a patient with two studies is two cases.

deidentification_status.description: MOS-EVID-012 and MOS-EVID-021. MOS-STORE-292a: this is NOT patients.phi_state, the two MUST NOT be conflated and a query MUST NOT join on them notwithstanding the two shared tokens.

status.description: MOS-EVID-014. The only evidence state on the row that moves, and it moves one way: a version found defective is marked, never edited and never deleted. No route on this surface sets it.

erasure_state.description: MOS-STORE-292: mutable for erasure, never for content. A cohort containing an erased subject is still the cohort a past report cited, which is why the flag exists instead of a deletion.

usable_for_new_runs.description: False once the version may no longer found a new run. MOS-UI-151 requires the console to re-verify the preconditions a submitted run would itself enforce, and this is the cheapest of them to read.
